test_cases.name: ASM SDK importable
test_cases.command: python3 -c "from huaweicloudsdkasm.v1 import AsmClient, ListMeshesRequest; print('SDK OK')"

test_cases.name: List all ASM meshes live (SDK)
test_cases.command: python3 -c "import os; from huaweicloudsdkcore.auth.credentials import BasicCredentials; from huaweicloudsdkasm.v1 import AsmClient, ListMeshesRequest; from huaweicloudsdkasm.v1.region.asm_region import AsmRegion; c=AsmClient.new_builder().with_credentials(BasicCredentials(os.environ['HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_AK'], os.environ['HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_SK'])).with_region(AsmRegion.value_of('cn-north-4')).build(); r=c.list_meshes(ListMeshesRequest()); print('total meshes:', len(r.items or [])); [print(m.metadata.name, m.metadata.uid, m.status.phase) for m in (r.items or [])]"
test_cases.expected: total meshes: N (N >= 0); each mesh line has name/uid/phase

test_cases.name: Fuzzy match meshes by name (keyword='a')
test_cases.command: python3 -c "import os; from huaweicloudsdkcore.auth.credentials import BasicCredentials; from huaweicloudsdkasm.v1 import AsmClient, ListMeshesRequest; from huaweicloudsdkasm.v1.region.asm_region import AsmRegion; c=AsmClient.new_builder().with_credentials(BasicCredentials(os.environ['HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_AK'], os.environ['HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_SK'])).with_region(AsmRegion.value_of('cn-north-4')).build(); r=c.list_meshes(ListMeshesRequest()); m2=[m for m in (r.items or []) if 'a' in (m.metadata.name or '').lower()]; print('matched', len(m2))"
test_cases.expected: matched N (N = number of meshes whose name contains 'a')

test_cases.name: Fuzzy match no-match keyword returns 0
test_cases.command: python3 -c "import os; from huaweicloudsdkcore.auth.credentials import BasicCredentials; from huaweicloudsdkasm.v1 import AsmClient, ListMeshesRequest; from huaweicloudsdkasm.v1.region.asm_region import AsmRegion; c=AsmClient.new_builder().with_credentials(BasicCredentials(os.environ['HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_AK'], os.environ['HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_SK'])).with_region(AsmRegion.value_of('cn-north-4')).build(); r=c.list_meshes(ListMeshesRequest()); m2=[m for m in (r.items or []) if 'zzzz_no_match_zzzz' in (m.metadata.name or '').lower()]; print('matched', len(m2))"

test_cases.name: Verify GET list endpoint from SDK _http_info
test_cases.command: python3 -c "from huaweicloudsdkasm.v1.asm_client import AsmClient; import inspect; src=inspect.getsource(AsmClient._list_meshes_http_info); assert '/v1/{project_id}/meshes' in src; assert 'GET' in src; print('endpoint OK')"

notes: Read-only queries only. No create/update/delete operations. CLI not applicable (hcloud ASM unsupported).
